about_the_game:
ONE PERSISTENT WORLD

Explore a colorful and stylized version of the real world, shared by all players, where all your actions matter. What one player does unlocks new possibilities for the entire community. Hop on in and let’s reshape the world together!

Read on to find out how to get VIP Access to Earthscaper now!

SIGN UP NOW FOR VIP ACCESS

Earthscaper is an inherently social game, and in order to “Reshape the World Together”, we need your input! Join our Discord now (link in sidebar) for a chance to get exlusive VIP access to Earthscaper and share your feedback to help shape its further development. There’s even more to explore beyond this version – be part of the journey as we build the full experience!

CREATE YOUR OWN CONTENT

Craft unique experiences, create fun minigames for the community, or participate in challenges made by other players! Explore the world to discover new sights and compete in various player-made activities, from parkours to escape rooms. Simply grab an open plot and use it to showcase your skills and creativity within Earthscaper.


BUILD TOGETHER

Design buildings, home bases, and fun minigames along with other players and share your creations with the community. Team up to build elaborate and challenging minigames for the toughest contenders, or gather your team for large-scale, time-based events where you’ll complete monumental building projects around the city, like reshaping the Brandenburg Gate!

A REWARDING EXPERIENCE

Complete quests and challenges to level up your Badges, earn currencies, and unlock exclusive cosmetics. Discover Galleries scattered around the world, where you can purchase avatar customizations, new decoration blocks, or unlock new block colors and textures.

BUILDING MADE FUN

Build bigger, faster, and smarter than ever before! With Earthscaper’s intuitive tools, you can snap blocks together effortlessly or scale up with powerful building features that let you construct grand creations in no time. Take your builds to the next level with interactive elements like teleportation blocks, speed boosts, countdown timers, and even dangerous lasers! Link them together with custom behaviors and logic to design intricate challenges, thrilling minigames, or mind-bending puzzles. If you can imagine it, you can build it!

Note that the game is in an early stage and all descriptions and images are subject to change.
